frozen_before: any Sprint-5A agent output (brainSCOPE typed evidence, sc-eQTL coloc, multi-trait coloc, PolyFun, PoPS, PsychENCODE developmental, GTEx V11) or any Gate-A within-family association value was viewed
inherits: research/sprint5/protocol_rules.json (sha256 f8ad4b0a...; amendments A1, A2) - all Sprint-5 gene classes, strata and precedence apply unchanged
gate_a: run exactly as frozen in research/sprint4/frozen_hypotheses.json (implementation note 2026-09-24: AF from 1000G EUR reference; Tweedie primary, EB sensitivity). Its locus results enter Sprint-5 locus confidence as the WITHIN_FAMILY lineage (Sprint-5 rule: counts_as_replication true), slope estimated by IVW over all testable loci before any locus is inspected; overlap caveat: Howe sibling sample includes UKB (8,061) and Generation Scotland

new_evidence_mapping.sc_eqtl_coloc_PPH4_ge_0.8: QTL class; collapses with bulk QTL (one class) because the single-cell cohorts overlap ROSMAP/CommonMind donors or the same GWAS signal; adds cell-type and direction information
new_evidence_mapping.brainscope_DIRECT_VARIANT_GENE_OVERLAP_o: cell-type direction layer only (not a QTL vote: no coloc possible)
new_evidence_mapping.brainscope_REGULATORY_ELEMENT_SUPPORT: ENHANCER_LINK only if the element-gene link is chromatin/activity-based (e.g. bcCRE linked by an ABC/rE2G-type model); a peak overlap without a gene link is annotation only
new_evidence_mapping.polyfun_susie: sensitivity fine-mapping: CODING class still requires plain SuSiE or Open Targets PIP >= 0.1 (>= 0.5 for the HIGH criterion); variants that pass only under PolyFun priors are flagged FUNCTIONAL_PRIOR_ONLY, never counted
new_evidence_mapping.pops: orthogonal polygenic prioritisation; never a V2G vote; reported and shown beside gene classes
new_evidence_mapping.multitrait_coloc_hyprcoloc: descriptive cross-phenotype sharing; overlapping samples (UKB, HRS, BATS) mean clusters are not independent replications
new_evidence_mapping.alphagenome: NOT_TESTABLE while no key; if later available it is SEQUENCE_MODEL class and needs observed human QTL agreement for weight
new_evidence_mapping.gtex_v11: if V11 QTLs are open they join the bulk QTL class (same GTEx donors -> no new independence unit)

likelihood_components.locus: summed log10 Bayes factor over counted independent lineages (G&C + within-family if testable)
likelihood_components.variant: max PIP of the lead credible set (plain SuSiE primary; PolyFun sensitivity)
likelihood_components.gene: Sprint-5 gene class and number of distinct V2G classes (no calibrated probability)
likelihood_components.adult_activity: ordinal: adult sc-eQTL coloc > adult bulk coloc > brainSCOPE cell-type QTL lookup > adult expression only > none
likelihood_components.calibration_statement: none of these are calibrated probabilities; they are reported as Bayes factors, strata and likelihood components with uncertainty

shortlists.A_causal_cognition_genes: genes ordered by Sprint-5 gene class then n classes then locus log10BF; only genes with gene-level evidence
shortlists.B_exceptional_or_quantitative: genes/loci whose support includes the extreme-IQ or math stream with the dependence of that stream stated; empty is allowed
shortlists.C_adult_modifiable_research: genes meeting the adult intervention gate criteria 1-4 at least at 'near' level; empty is allowed and must not be forced
